Mathematical Definition
The energy E_\infty of a continuous-time signal x(t) is defined as:
E_\infty = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} |x(t)|^2 dt
If the energy is finite (0 < E_\infty < \infty), we call x(t) an energy signal.

Practice Task

Calculate the energy of a unit step function u(t).
Determine if the signal is power or energy dominant.
